campaign: Advisor Event Marketing — FA Events Wave 1 (immersive primary)
compliance_notes: LOCAL PREVIEW ONLY — carries Mileage's own pricing. Branch claude/md-fa-events-preview is never pushed.
Copy is Patrick O'Sullivan's v2 draft. Stylometry PASS; copy-QA and the 5-agent ad review board have NOT run.
Ads 1-3 IMMERSIVE (primary, Bill's direction 2026-07-30). Ads 4-6 type-dominant challenger. Ads 7-9 founder-led. Ads 10-14 carousel.
Imagery is Nano Banana Pro. Rooms only — no people, no faces, no synthetic advisors, no generated text.
No client named, described or located. No city names. No signage or landmarks in any frame.
Every figure on a frame traces to the assignment brief or the approved deck.

ads.title: C1 Seat Count — IMMERSIVE (primary)
ads.production: Figma Ad/Master — treatment=Immersive. Nano Banana Pro room photography.
ads.primary_text:
Forty seats, six weeks out, and the room isn't full yet.

We build and run the Meta campaign that fills it. Two advisor events this spring: the first came in at $69.25 per registered seat, the second at $37.08. Both times the client shut the ads off before the end date because the room hit capacity.

$1,400/month, three-month minimum. Ad spend is separate and goes straight to Meta.

Fifteen minutes is enough to tell you whether the math works for your event.
ads.headline: Both Events Hit Capacity Early
ads.hook: Forty seats, six weeks out, and the room isn't full yet.
ads.image_direction: The room set and waiting. Plate Standard (band mean 0.0052, logo band drove escalation).

ads.title: C2 Cost Per Seat — IMMERSIVE (primary)
ads.production: Figma Ad/Master — treatment=Immersive. Nano Banana Pro room photography.
ads.primary_text:
$37.08 per registered seat at the last advisor event we filled.

That's ad spend. Add our fee across the three months and it comes to $134.77 all in. The campaign before it ran $69.25 per seat, $192.76 loaded. We learned what pulled on the first one and the second got cheaper.

$1,400/month, three-month minimum. Ad spend is separate and goes straight to Meta.

Fifteen minutes and you'll know what your event would cost to fill.

ads.hook: $37.08 per registered seat at the last advisor event we filled.

ads.title: C3 Capacity — IMMERSIVE (primary)
ads.production: Figma Ad/Master — treatment=Immersive. Nano Banana Pro room photography.
ads.primary_text:
The client called and asked us to turn the ads off. The event was full.

That happened on both advisor event campaigns we ran this spring. The first filled at $69.25 per registered seat, the second at $37.08. Neither one got to spend its whole budget.

We build the audience, write the ads, run the creative refresh, and watch the seat count against the spend. Our goal is always to be paused for capacity, never for performance.

$1,400/month, three-month minimum. Ad spend is separate and goes straight to Meta.
